title: SmartContractAuditFindings
description: Canonical output shape for all specialist subagents

agent.description: Name of the specialist agent that produced this file

contract.description: Path to the audited contract file

id.description: Unique finding ID: <AGENT_PREFIX>-<THREE_DIGIT_NUMBER>. e.g. RE-001, AC-002. DS- for dos, SN- for snapshot

title.description: One-line summary of the finding. Max 80 chars.

vuln_type.description: Taxonomy tag matching Solodit knowledge base categories

description.description: Full explanation of the vulnerability: what it is, why it exists, and what an attacker can do with it.

code_snippet.description: The exact vulnerable lines from the contract

impact.description: Concrete worst-case outcome: funds drained, access gained, contract bricked, etc.

proof_of_concept.description: Optional: attack scenario or Foundry test skeleton demonstrating exploitability

recommendation.description: Specific, actionable fix with corrected code where possible

references.description: Related Solodit findings or EIPs that informed this finding

confidence.description: How certain is the agent that this is a real issue, not a false positive

duplicate_of.description: If this finding overlaps another, set to the other finding's ID. Report generator will merge them.

invariant_violated.description: Invariant ID from data/invariants/protocol_invariants.json if this finding violates a named invariant

thread_id.description: Deep trace thread ID if this finding originated from the deep_trace stage

interaction_chain_id.description: Call graph chain ID from the interaction mapper if applicable

trace_depth.description: How many contract hops deep the vulnerability is (from deep trace hop_traces)

ite.description: ITE framework decomposition (Jason Hadex methodology): Intent, Technique, Evasion

intent.description: What the attacker achieves — one sentence naming the victim and the loss

technique.description: How the attack is executed — specific call sequence with line references

evasion.description: What protection the developer intended and what the exact gap is

confirmation_passes.description: Number of multi-pass confirmation runs that returned YES

confirmation_score.description: Fraction of confirmation passes that returned YES (0.0–1.0)

human_review_required.description: True if this finding requires human auditor validation before submission

human_review_reason.description: Why human review is required (confirmation_score too low, novel pattern, etc.)

attack_surface_rank.description: Attack surface score 1–5 from attacker_mindset agent for the affected function

manifest_refs.description: Coverage-manifest item ids this finding targets (from output/coverage_manifest.json). Populated by agents or best-effort by scripts/link_findings_to_manifest.py. Used by the coverage gate (disposition status 'finding') and min_confirm_gate. Optional in the schema; strictness is enforced at gate time via coverage_policy.finding_requires_manifest_refs.

bsa_metadata.description: Behavioral State Analysis metadata — only set by the behavioral_state_analysis agent

stated_intent.description: The intent expressed in NatSpec or comments

defense_mapping.description: Defense coverage assessment produced by defense_mapper.py. Set after Step 1.5.

evasion_path.description: How the attack bypasses the defense, or empty string if no bypass identified

inherited_from.description: Parent contract name if the blocking defense is inherited

invalidation_tags.description: Hard invalidation tags applied by pre_submission_gate.py. Any tag blocks submission.

assumption_count.description: Number of preconditions the exploit requires that are not guaranteed by the protocol. Low = more reliable exploit, high = brittle FP candidate.

critical_assumptions.description: Named preconditions the exploit depends on that are not protocol-guaranteed. Feeds ground-truth calibration.

cross_agent_refs.description: IDs of findings from other specialist agents that touch the same function or state variable. Populated by specialist agents during Step 2. Used by cross_agent_connector and synthesize_compound_findings to prioritize pair evaluation.

compound_with.description: IDs of other findings that combine with this one into a compound exploit path. Set by cross_agent_connector.py when severity does not escalate (annotation-only mode).

cross_agent_note.description: Human-readable description of the compound path when compound_with is set but no new CC_CA finding was created.

ice_chain.description: Impact Chain Escalation metadata. Agents SHOULD populate this before submitting a finding. If consumer_found=false, the finding is auto-routed to poc_required at triage.

corrupted_state.description: The state variable or storage slot that the vulnerability corrupts (e.g. 'balances[attacker]', '_isManager[addr]')

consumer_found.description: Whether a trusted protocol consumer of the corrupted state was identified. false = auto-routes to poc_required.

consumer_function.description: The function that reads/uses the corrupted state (e.g. 'withdraw()', 'isInManagement()')

consumer_action.description: What the consumer does with the corrupted state — the worst-case protocol action (e.g. 'transfers ETH', 'grants mint rights')

severity_ceiling.description: Maximum severity supported by the identified consumer chain. Caps claimed severity.
